row.title: Memory staleness is a main-only failure
row.body: check_memory.py treated staleness as advisory only for the pull_request event; the lane runs checks on bot PRs with workflow_dispatch on the PR branch, so the branch sweep PR (38 merged commits) failed on staleness alone. MEMORY-REF-1: hard failure only when GITHUB_REF is refs/heads/main; tests/test_check_memory_ref.py covers both refs.

title: Memory staleness is a main-only failure
